SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.city = 'Berlin' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS berlin_quantity,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.city = 'Berlin' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(i.quantity) * 100 AS berlin_percentage
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN 
    warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name
HAVING 
    SUM(i.quantity) > 0 AND 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN w.city = 'Berlin' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(i.quantity)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    berlin_percentage DESC;

    DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_order_value,
    LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')) AS previous_month_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m'))) / LAG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')) * 100
    END AS month_over_month_growth_percentage
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY order_month
ORDER BY order_month;
